name: Compare role permissions
description: Admin form that compares the permissions of two user roles side by side, listing only the permissions that differ. Read-only audit aid; does not grant or revoke permissions.
project_description:
This module can be used to compare the permissions between two different roles. This module can be really handy when you are facing permission related issues and you are not sure which particular permission string is leading to the unexpected behavior for a particular role.

 Steps for using this module

 
 Enable the module. 
 Visit http://example.com/admin/people/permissions/crp 
 Select two different roles that you would like to compare and hit Submit 
 
 Your suggestions are most welcome.
